notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over the subtle crate. ConstantTimeCopy and XORBytes panic with Go's messages. WithDataIndependentTiming is a deviation: stable Rust has no safe way to set the CPU's data-independent timing mode, so the function only runs its argument.

WithDataIndependentTiming.note: Go sets the ARM64 DIT bit (and similar CPU modes) for the duration of f; that needs assembly or unsafe code, which this crate forbids, so the function only calls f.
